besluite.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('die n.C.-jare kom' / 'die v.C.-jare kom').
besluite.rede: Required comma between two full clauses; meaning and protected forms untouched.
Intransitive 'tel agteruit' is natural Afrikaans (as in 'die klok tel af'); the passive is longer and stiffer for a Grade 4 reader.

besluite.fout: 'n Tydlyn van links na regs' is compressed and makes a reader pause over whether it describes the line or its direction.
besluite.rede: The short relative clause states the direction plainly, matches 'loop' in the later block, and keeps every protected word and the meaning intact.

besluite.fout: 'Jy merk die gebeure op die tydlyn' can be misread as the separable verb 'opmerk' (notice) on a first reading.
besluite.rede: 'Plaas' names the same action without the stumble and leaves 'tydlyn' and the rest of the sentence unchanged.

besluite.fout: 'Aangee' on its own reads like handing an object across rather than passing heritage on to later generations.
besluite.rede: This is a glossary definition, so even a sound verb improvement must go through the writer for every lesson at once.
